title: A Day in the Deep Blue

paragraphs.text: Last Sunday, my class went to Ocean Park. The bus ride was longer than we thought. But we sang songs all the way. Soon, we saw the big blue gate.
paragraphs.translation: 上周日，我们班去了海洋乐园。车程比我们想的要长。不过我们一路都在唱歌。很快，我们就看到了那扇蓝色的大门。

paragraphs.text: Our guide was a woman named Ms. Li. She was taller than our teacher. She gave us a small map. "The sea is a big family," she said.
paragraphs.translation: 我们的向导是一位叫李女士的阿姨。她比我们老师还高。她给了我们一张小地图。"海洋是一个大家庭，"她说。

paragraphs.text: First, we visited the dolphin pool. The dolphins were faster than the fish. One dolphin jumped and splashed us. We laughed and clapped our hands.
paragraphs.translation: 我们先去了海豚池。海豚比鱼游得快多了。一只海豚跳起来，把水花溅到我们身上。我们笑着拍起了手。

paragraphs.text: Then we walked into a glass tunnel. Fish of many colors swam above us. A turtle moved slower than the others. It looked old and very kind.
paragraphs.translation: 然后我们走进了一条玻璃隧道。五颜六色的鱼在我们头顶游来游去。一只海龟比别的动物游得慢。它看上去又老又和善。

paragraphs.text: After lunch, we saw lots of plastic bags. They floated in the water like jellyfish. Ms. Li said, "This is bad for fish." We picked up every bag we found.
paragraphs.translation: 午饭过后，我们看到了很多塑料袋。它们像水母一样漂在水里。李女士说："这对鱼可不好。"我们把找到的每个袋子都捡了起来。

paragraphs.text: On the way home, we felt proud. The ocean was cleaner than before. I told Mom I wanted to help. She smiled and said, "You already did."
paragraphs.translation: 回家的路上，我们感到很自豪。海洋比以前干净了。我告诉妈妈我想帮忙。她笑着说："你已经做到了。"
